The name '''Bashere''' can refer to the following people as well as the location in [[Saldaea]]:

*[[Davram t'Ghaline Bashere]] - [[Marshal-General]] to Queen Tenobia si Bashere Kazadi and General for [[Rand al'Thor]], the [[Dragon Reborn]].
*[[Deira ni Ghaline t'Bashere]] - wife of Davram and mother of Zarine.
*[[Zarine ni Bashere t'Aybara]] - commonly called Faile, wife of [[Perrin Aybara]] and cousin of Queen Tenobia.
*[[Maedin Bashere]] - younger brother of Zarine and cousin of Queen Tenobia.
*[[Tenobia si Bashere Kazadi]] - Queen of Saldaea and niece to Davram and Deira.
*[[Bashere (location)|Bashere]] - a region in Saldaea.
